findings.title: Worker leave request submission always fails due to reading nonexistent membership id from session user
findings.scenario: Omar logs into the web dashboard and opens My Leave to submit annual leave for his shifts at Tom's pharmacy. The pharmacy selector assigns an undefined membership value because pharmacy memberships in the session profile omit the membership record identifier. When Omar submits the form, the server receives a missing membership parameter and rejects the request with a permission error, completely blocking him from requesting leave.
findings.test_needed: Submit a leave request from MyLeavePage using an authenticated worker whose profile memberships contain pharmacy details without an id attribute, asserting that a valid membership identifier is supplied to the API rather than null or NaN.

owner_question.question: When Omar requests leave on the web dashboard, how should the application identify his active pharmacy membership?
options: Include the membership primary key on pharmacy memberships in the user profile payload so Omar's leave request submits a valid membership identifier.
Update the leave creation endpoint to accept the pharmacy identifier directly and resolve Omar's active membership automatically.
Require workers to submit leave requests through mobile or ask Tom to enter it directly (keep today's behaviour).

findings.title: Timesheet detail drawer renders manager check resolution and punch actions in worker mode
findings.scenario: Omar opens My Hours to review his worked hours at Tom's pharmacy and inspects a timesheet with an attendance warning. Because the details drawer fails to pass worker mode into check cards, Omar is shown active Resolve and Waive buttons as well as an Add missing clock time button. When Omar attempts to resolve the check or add a missing clock time, the request is rejected with a 403 error because only pharmacy managers like Tom may approve or waive attendance checks.
findings.test_needed: Render TimesheetDetailDrawer with managerMode set to false and verify that CheckCard renders in read-only mode without Resolve, Waive, Reopen, or Add missing clock time buttons.

owner_question.question: When Omar reviews his own hours in the timesheet details drawer, how should checks and attendance issues be displayed?
options: Display checks in read-only mode with instructions for Omar to contact his manager Tom to correct source attendance.
Allow Omar to submit explanations as comments on the timesheet without showing direct resolution or waiving controls.
Leave the manager resolution and punch buttons visible to workers even though server permissions reject their submissions (keep today's behaviour).
